overview: Cytokinin promotes youthfulness and growth in plant tissue, while ethylene promotes ripening, ageing, and shedding.
genZNote: Cytokinin keeps the leaf young. Ethylene tells the whole plant it's time to let go.

aspects.label: Effect on Senescence
aspects.valueB: Promotes and accelerates senescence and abscission.

aspects.label: Example Use
aspects.valueA: Used to keep cut flowers fresh for longer.
aspects.valueB: Used to trigger uniform ripening in commercial fruit storage.

overlay.examHighYieldNote: Spraying cut flowers with cytokinin can measurably delay wilting by slowing senescence.
overlay.memoryTrick: Cytokinin = keep it fresh. Ethylene = let it ripen and fall.
overlay.commonMisconception: These two hormones aren't simply 'opposites' across the board — they can also act together, such as both influencing fruit development at different stages.
